dialogues.jp: 「しまった、完全に出遅れた……」
dialogues.en:
It's a beautiful day, and sometimes it's nice to relax
outside.
dialogues.text:
It's a beautiful day, and sometimes it's nice to relax
outside.

dialogues.jp:
恒例のパン争奪戦に、俺は戦わずして白旗を揚
げなければならなかった。
ついうとうとしてしまったのが敗因だ……。
dialogues.en: I walked slowly, enjoying the warm sun on my body.
dialogues.text: I walked slowly, enjoying the warm sun on my body.

dialogues.jp:
いや、そもそもこの暖房の効いた部屋がいけな
い。
dialogues.en: "It's like a proper walk."
dialogues.text: "It's like a proper walk."

dialogues.jp:
３月にもなっていないというのに、日差しも温
かく、まさにダブルパンチとはこのことだ。
dialogues.en: I guess it is a proper walk......
dialogues.text: I guess it is a proper walk......

dialogues.jp:
いったい誰が睡魔を堪えることができようか？
いや、できない！！
そう、悪いのは俺じゃない！
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei was looking around as if she was trying to
find something.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei was looking around as if she was trying to
find something.

dialogues.jp: 陽気だ！！
dialogues.en: "Are you looking for something?"
dialogues.text: "Are you looking for something?"

dialogues.jp: この陽気が悪いんだ！！
dialogues.en: She kept looking around while talking.
dialogues.text: She kept looking around while talking.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「……何こぶしを振り上げて力説してるんだ、
　朝倉？」
dialogues.en: She must have lost something very important.
dialogues.text: She must have lost something very important.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.en: "Asakura, did you see a cat?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura, did you see a cat?"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp: 「……もうすぐ春だからな」
dialogues.en: "A cat?"
dialogues.text: "A cat?"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp: 「……それでついにおかしくなった、と」
dialogues.en: Did she lose her cat?
dialogues.text: Did she lose her cat?

dialogues.jp:
……何かとてつもなく失礼な言葉が聞こえた様
な気がするが、聞き流してやることにする。
dialogues.en: "Oh, that cat."
dialogues.text: "Oh, that cat."

dialogues.jp: 「それにしても、随分と余裕だな」
dialogues.en: "No, I haven't seen it."
dialogues.text: "No, I haven't seen it."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「何がだ？」
dialogues.en: "But why are you looking for Sakura's cat?"
dialogues.text: "But why are you looking for Sakura's cat?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「食堂に急がなくていいのか？それとももう諦
　めたのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I was interested to know how that cat walks on two
legs. I thought of opening it up to check how it is
possible."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I was interested to know how that cat walks on two
legs. I thought of opening it up to check how it is
possible."

dialogues.jp:
それなら先ほどの無礼な物言いを忘れて、同士
に加えてやろうではないか。

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.en: She thought of opening it up......?
dialogues.text: She thought of opening it up......?

dialogues.jp: うんうん。
dialogues.en: "Isn't your specialty in General Engineering?"
dialogues.text: "Isn't your specialty in General Engineering?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「俺、弁当持参組だからな」
dialogues.en: "Not only that, but also Artificial Intelligence."
dialogues.text: "Not only that, but also Artificial Intelligence."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……かったる」
dialogues.en:
"The other teachers are pretending that they're not
interested, but I never know if they mean it or not."
dialogues.text:
"The other teachers are pretending that they're not
interested, but I never know if they mean it or not."

dialogues.jp: ◆春の過ごし方◆
dialogues.en: ◆Koyomi-sensei and Utamaru◆
dialogues.text: ◆Koyomi-sensei and Utamaru◆

dialogues.jp: 春の日差しに誘われて……。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei was looking for a cat.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei was looking for a cat.

dialogues.jp: 昼食の争奪戦に遅れてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I found out that the cat she was looking for was Utamaru.
She said she is interested in opening up the cat for her
curiosity, but I don't like that idea......
dialogues.text:
I found out that the cat she was looking for was Utamaru.
She said she is interested in opening up the cat for her
curiosity, but I don't like that idea......

dialogues.jp: かったるい……。
dialogues.en: "Shall I sunbathe in the center court?"
dialogues.text: "Shall I sunbathe in the center court?"
